titleEn: The Best of Friends Must Part
titleZh: 再好的朋友也有分別時

items.promptEn: Two close friends will study in different cities after graduation and plan to meet during holidays.
items.promptZh: 兩位好友畢業後要到不同城市讀書，約好假期再見。

options.text: The friends will say goodbye without ending their friendship—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 分別確實發生，友誼未因此終止。

options.text: The friends have ended their friendship in anger—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 原文沒有吵架或絕交。

options.text: The friends will attend the same school next term—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 兩人去不同城市。

options.text: Their holiday plan proves they will never miss each other—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 約好見面不代表不會想念。

items.promptZh: 童年朋友送阿晴上火車，兩人答應繼續通話。

options.text: They must part at the station although they intend to stay close—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 月台告別與保留友誼兼容。

options.text: They have decided never to speak again—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 原文說會繼續通話。

options.text: They are travelling on the same train together—the best of friends must part.

options.text: A telephone promise means no goodbye is needed—the best of friends must part.

options.text: The friends must say goodbye as camp ends—the best of friends must part.

options.text: The friends must have quarrelled at camp—the best of friends must part.

options.text: The friends will remain at camp forever—the best of friends must part.

options.text: They part at the airport while planning to keep in touch—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 移民造成分別，仍可維繫情誼。

options.text: They stop being friends at the airport—the best of friends must part.

options.text: They will continue living in the same city—the best of friends must part.

options.text: Monthly calls prove that parting will not feel sad—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 通話不能證明完全不難過。

items.promptZh: 兩位老同事退休後各自搬家，最後一次一起走出辦公室。

options.text: Their shared work chapter ends as they part—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 長期相處者有告別時刻。

options.text: Their friendship ended because of a quarrel—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 沒有爭吵。

options.text: They both return to the same desk tomorrow—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 退休後不會明天回同一座位。

options.text: Retirement proves they cannot meet again—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 告別工作不等於永不再見。

items.promptZh: 假期最後一晚，兩個好友交換地址，第二天各自回國。

options.text: They part tomorrow while leaving a way to stay connected—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 回國令好友分別，交換地址保留聯絡可能。

options.text: They refuse to exchange any contact details—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 原文明確說交換地址。

options.text: They have no travel plans and will stay together—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 兩人第二天回國。

options.text: Exchanging addresses guarantees daily letters—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 交換地址不保證每日寫信。

items.promptEn: Two friends who learned piano together since childhood will join different orchestras next year.
items.promptZh: 兩個從小一起學琴的朋友，明年會進入不同的樂團。

options.text: Their paths separate although their friendship may continue—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 走不同音樂道路不等於關係破裂。

options.text: Different orchestras prove they dislike each other—the best of friends must part.

options.text: They will join one orchestra together—the best of friends must part.

options.text: Their friendship must end next year—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 諺語不預言絕交。

items.promptZh: 阿珊最後一次為搬走的好友送午餐，兩人說會保持聯絡。

options.text: Their farewell marks a parting, not necessarily a broken friendship—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 送別與保持聯絡可同時成立。

options.text: They have chosen to stop contacting each other—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 原文說會保持聯絡。

options.text: The friend is moving into Shan’s building—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 好友要搬走。

options.text: The lunch proves they will meet every day—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 午餐不能保證日後每日見面。

items.promptEn: Camp volunteers have worked together all summer and hug goodbye when the programme ends.
items.promptZh: 營地義工一起工作了整個暑假，活動結束時互相擁抱道別。

options.text: The volunteers part after a close summer together—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 暑假結束帶來友好而真實的分別。

options.text: The volunteers never worked together—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 原文說整個暑假一起工作。

options.text: The programme will continue indefinitely—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 活動已結束。

options.text: A goodbye hug proves they will not meet again—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 擁抱不能證明永不重逢。

items.promptEn: Two friends as close as sisters live apart after one marries and moves away; they still write regularly.
items.promptZh: 姊妹般親近的兩位朋友，一人結婚後搬到外地，兩人仍定期寫信。

options.text: The friends live apart while keeping their bond alive—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 分居而仍寫信，顯示分別不等於絕交。

options.text: The friends stopped caring after the move—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 原文說仍定期寫信。

options.text: They still live on the same street—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 一人搬到外地。

options.text: Writing letters means they did not have to say goodbye—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 有書信往來仍需面對分別。

items.promptEn: After their team’s last game, two friends will join different clubs.
items.promptZh: 球隊最後一場比賽後，兩位好友將加入不同球會。

options.text: Their time as teammates ends even if their friendship does not—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 球隊道路分開，友情可延續。

options.text: Joining different clubs proves they were enemies—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 沒有敵對關係。

options.text: They will remain on the same team next season—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 原文說加入不同球會。

options.text: The last game proves they will never play again—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 最後一場是此隊比賽，不是終身告別球場。

items.promptEn: After a week-long visit, two good friends wave goodbye at the pier and plan to reunite in winter.
items.promptZh: 探訪一週後，兩位好朋友在碼頭揮手告別，約定冬天再見。

options.text: They part now despite hoping to meet again in winter—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 現在分別與將來重聚並不矛盾。

options.text: Their goodbye means the friendship is over—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 原文沒有友誼結束。

options.text: They are still at the start of the visit—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 探訪已到尾聲。

options.text: A winter plan means the present farewell is not real—the best of friends must part.
options.reasonZh: 冬天再見不取消今天的告別。

meaning.zh: 再親近的朋友，也會有暫時或長久分別的時候。
meaning.en: Even very close friends sometimes have to part.

model.zh: 畢業禮後，兩位多年的好友要到不同城市升學。
model.en: After graduation, the two old friends were heading to different cities—the best of friends must part.

picture.zh: 想像兩條路在同一個路口分開；情誼可以保留，行程卻不同。
picture.en: Picture two paths dividing at a junction; the friendship can remain even as journeys diverge.

boundary.zh: 「分別」不等於吵架、絕交或永不再見。
boundary.en: Parting does not itself mean a quarrel, a broken friendship, or never meeting again.

where.zh: 適合畢業、搬遷、旅程結束等告別場合；對剛失去親友的人須留意語氣。
where.en: Use it for graduation, moving away, or the end of a visit; speak gently around bereavement.

tone.zh: 通常帶傷感但可作溫柔的接受，不是責怪朋友離開。
tone.en: Usually wistful yet accepting, not a rebuke to the departing friend.

checks.zh: 這真是朋友分別的時刻嗎？
我有沒有誤指關係破裂？
checks.en: Am I implying a broken bond?

checks.zh: 場合需要安慰，還是需要實際安排？
checks.en: Does the moment call for comfort or plans?

readAloud.zh: 列車快開了，兩個從小認識的朋友最後擁抱道別。
readAloud.en: The train was leaving, so the childhood friends hugged goodbye—the best of friends must part.

options.zh: 兩位好友互相珍惜，但新學期要到不同城市。
options.en: Two close friends value each other, but they will study in different cities.
options.reasonZh: 友誼仍在，分別確實發生。

options.zh: 兩位好友同班上課，放學後一起回家。
options.en: Two close friends attend the same class and walk home together.
options.reasonZh: 尚未有分別情境。

options.zh: 兩人因欺騙而絕交，並說從未是朋友。
options.en: Two people end a friendship after a betrayal and deny they were ever friends.
options.reasonZh: 焦點是關係破裂，不是友好而不得不分別。

prompt.zh: 好友即將搬走，哪個回應較合適？
prompt.en: A close friend is moving away. Which reply fits the moment?

options.zh: 「我會想你；到埗後我們再約時間通話。」
options.en: “I’ll miss you. Let’s arrange a call once you’ve arrived.”
options.reasonZh: 承認不捨，也保留友誼。

options.zh: 「你搬走就代表我們不再是朋友。」
options.en: “Moving away means we can no longer be friends.”
options.reasonZh: 把距離誤當作友誼終止。

options.zh: 「既然大家終會分別，就不用好好道別。」
options.en: “Because friends must part, there is no point saying goodbye properly.”
options.reasonZh: 諺語沒有否定道別的重要。

prompt.zh: 營會最後一晚，好友明天要回不同城市。哪句自然？
prompt.en: At the end of camp, close friends return to different cities tomorrow. Which line sounds natural?

options.zh: 「今晚好好道別吧；再好的朋友也有分別時。」
options.en: “Let’s say a proper goodbye tonight—the best of friends must part.”
options.reasonZh: 友好與分別兩個事實都保留。

options.zh: 「我們已經絕交；再好的朋友也有分別時。」
options.en: “We have ended our friendship—the best of friends must part.”
options.reasonZh: 題目沒有說友誼結束。

options.zh: 「明天仍會住在一起；再好的朋友也有分別時。」
options.en: “We will still live together tomorrow—the best of friends must part.”
options.reasonZh: 與回不同城市的事實矛盾。

prompt.zh: 這句諺語不能證明甚麼？
prompt.en: What does the proverb not establish?

options.zh: 「分開後是否仍保持聯絡，要看兩人的選擇。」
options.en: “Whether they keep in touch depends on what they do next.”
options.reasonZh: 諺語只交代分別，沒有預定友誼結果。
把分別誤說成絕交。

options.zh: 「真正的朋友永遠不會離開同一城市。」
options.en: “True friends can never live in different cities.”
options.reasonZh: 親近朋友也可能各走各路。
